name: Restaurant-Pizzeria Alina
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria & Restaurant Alina in Breitenwang**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps! At **Pizzeria & Restaurant Alina** in **Breitenwang**, you’ll enjoy freshly baked pizzas with regional ingredients, handmade pasta, and a cozy atmosphere. Whether you’re craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, our menu has something for everyone. Don’t miss our delicious desserts—try the **Apfelstrudel** or a warm slice of **Kaiserschmarrn**!

Perfect for families, couples, or a night out with friends, **Alina** is just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and close to the slopes of **Breitenwang**. Come for the food, stay for the hospitality!
